FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE                                                                       23 September 2026
WPP PLC ("WPP")
Directorate Change - Chief Financial Officer Succession

WPP plc (LSE/NYSE:WPP) announces that Joanne Wilson is stepping down from her role as Chief Financial Officer and as an Executive Director of WPP, and will be taking up a new role as Chief Financial Officer of Diageo plc (LSE:DGE/NYSE:DEO).

Joanne will remain in her current role while her successor is appointed, to ensure an effective transition of her responsibilities. She has a 12-month notice period and a date for her departure will be agreed in due course.
The Board has commenced a formal search process to appoint a new Chief Financial Officer.

During her tenure, Joanne has played an important role in positioning WPP for the future and working with the executive team to build momentum in delivering the Company's Elevate28 growth strategy. Joanne will continue to support WPP through an orderly transition as the Company prepares to accelerate its transformation and return to growth.

Cindy Rose, Chief Executive Officer, said: "On behalf of the executive team, I would like to thank Joanne for her significant contribution over the past three years. She has been a valued partner as we have strengthened the business, sharpened our financial discipline and begun to deliver our phase one of Elevate28. I am grateful that Joanne will continue to work with me in ensuring continuity, a smooth handover and sustained focus on execution as we deliver on our strategy."

Joanne Wilson, Chief Financial Officer, said: "I would like to thank everyone at WPP for their tremendous support over the past few years. I am incredibly proud of all we have achieved. We have built firm foundations in the first phase of Elevate28 to successfully deliver against WPP's strategy."
Our guidance for 2026 is unchanged from that provided alongside our Interim Results on 6 August 2026.
This announcement has been made pursuant to the Financial Conduct Authority's UK Listing Rule 6.4.6R.
